verdict.rationale: Baseten documents first-party function/tool calling on its Model APIs, where the model chooses a tool and generates its arguments. It also offers OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints and JSON-schema structured outputs, which support agent-style use. However, nothing in the evidence addresses parallel tool calls, multi-step tool loops, or how faithfully tool calls are produced, so only the core capability is shown. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step tool-use loops, evidence of tool-call reliability on open models, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking

citations.quote: Function calling (also called tool calling) lets a model choose a tool and produce its arguments from a user request.
Structured outputs let you generate text that conforms to specific JSON schemas, providing reliable data extraction and controlled text generation.
OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints for high-performance LLMs
